title.default: A studio built on a single conviction

default.text: Interior Specifics began with the belief that every accomplished person deserves a space that reflects their journey. What started as a boutique practice has grown into one of Lagos' most trusted luxury design firms, with over 200 completed projects.

Today we offer a complete service — architecture, interiors, sourcing, finishing and project management — all under one roof, so our clients enjoy a seamless, stress-free experience from first sketch to final styling.

default.title: Our Mission
default.body: To design and deliver exceptional spaces that elevate how our clients live, work and feel — with absolute craft and complete peace of mind.

default.title: Our Vision
default.body: To be West Africa's most respected name in luxury interior design — the natural choice for those who expect the very best.
